description.name: Entry
description.text:
Damage +5% to Sharpshooters, Master Mode, Instant ATB 1 & Diffusion Barrier 1 to user
Master Mode: Cap Break Level 4, Zero SB Cost 1 & Instant SB/LB Cast 1
Interval Chase: 10 single-target Fire/NE or Lightning/NE ranged physical attacks under En-Fire or En-Lightning, Damage +10/15/20/25/30% to party after 1/2/3/4/5 chases (max 5 chases)
Master Chase: Single-target Fire/Lightning/NE ranged physical attack at True Cap Break Level 1, Damage +30% to Sharpshooters, removes Master Mode
